title: Benzo[d]imidazole anchored oxadiazole derivatives: synthesis, characterization, biological evaluation, in silico docking and ADME-T analysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,12702-12712
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09260D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yellamanda Rao Salluri, Kalyani Chepuri, Shaik Anwar
A series of eleven hybrid derivatives were synthesized from benzo[d]imidazoles anchored with 1,2,4-oxadiazoles and 1,3,4-oxadiazoles and displayed antibacterial properties. Compound 8b and 8i had the highest zone of inhibition and lowest MIC values.
